sloka: तमापन्तमाकाशे द्रुमवर्षं प्रतापवान्।त्रिशिरा निसितैर्बाणैश्चिच्छेद च ननाद च ।। ६.७०.३६ ।।
transliteration: tamāpantamākāśe drumavarṣaṁ pratāpavān।triśirā nisitairbāṇaiściccheda ca nanāda ca ।। 6.70.36 ।।

translations.english: Stupendous Trisira tore with his whetted arrows the rain of trees through the sky and roared.
